title: New hospital building, Brisbane: excavation
workplace: New 10 storey hospital building with a two level basement and rooftop helipad, on an existing hospital campus next to the live hospital, Brisbane
note: Facts are example inputs for testing. On a real project they come from the contractor's own procedures and the project's documents.

swms.title: Bulk excavation for the basement
swms.task: Bulk excavate the two level basement with excavators and trucks, next to the live hospital, installing ground anchors in the retention wall as the excavation goes down.

facts.excavationPlan: Excavation follows the geotechnical design G-110 (revision C) in stages to the levels shown, with anchors installed and stressed before digging below each row, and plant and trucks follow the site traffic management plan TMP-02.

steps: Install, stress and later remove ground anchors and props
Protect the basement edge and provide access
Work next to the live hospital
